scientific_limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy rank and concentration are invoked from Chari–Joswig, Theorem 4.1.
Only the geometric dihedral action, not all abstract automorphisms, is determined.
Integral torsion of the dihedral orbit space and equivariant homotopy type are not computed.
The 2008 article on pure Morse complexes was available for abstract comparison only.
title: Integral dihedral homology of pure Morse complexes of cycles
